tasks.short: Select thread, twine, cord or yarn and thread actual needles.

steps.what: Select actual thread, twine, cord or yarn suited to the item and stitch requirements
inputs: actual item, fabric and stitch requirements
actual available thread, twine, cord or yarn

steps.what: Thread actual needles and verify physical readiness for the intended hand sewing
outputs: actual threaded needles ready for hand sewing

tasks.design: Keep physical material selection and needle threading with the hand sewer. A native stock/specification view can expose a material reference but cannot select the actual shade, condition and handling suitability or thread these needles.
tasks.previous_blocker: Actual sewing materials and needles need physical handling and suitability checks.
tasks.enabler_now: No supported software change to these particular physical actions.
tasks.still_hard: Actual material compatibility and needle readiness remain physical.
tasks.human_edge: The sewer detects an unsuitable actual thread despite a matching stock description.
tasks.altitude: No supported saving for these physical preparation actions.

evidence.claim: Model knowledge: displaying a thread reference does not perform actual thread selection or needle threading.

assumptions: Provisional selection65 and threading35 are scenario shares, not measured. Record/write/report/send boundaries inspected: this task scenario assigns no stock issue, job-card entry or written material request to the sewer. Any actual assigned entry must be added separately and assessed against native stock/job-card functions before applying this zero; it is not folded into physical handling.

No needle-threading hardware, robot, generated order or inventory feed is proposed. The digest's weaving-machine counts and nesting examples do not establish a change to hand needle threading. Do not invent paperwork to create a software baseline.
unknowns: Is any stock issue or job-card entry actually assigned here?
research_questions: Is there repeated information work separate from material selection and needle threading?

incremental.description: No software change is proposed, so no incremental maintenance work is assigned.

time_saved_range_pct.basis: Both bounds retain actual selection65 and threading35. No defined software change removes either action. Any actual assigned inventory/job-card write needs its own native-system assessment before applying this zero.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

tasks.short: Draw and cut actual patterns according to specifications.

steps.what: Interpret actual pattern specifications, dimensions, seam requirements and material constraints
outputs: checked pattern requirements and chosen dimensions

steps.what: Draw actual pattern geometry using checked dimensions and selected applicable pattern sections
inputs: checked pattern requirements and chosen dimensions

steps.what: Check the entire final pattern geometry, scale and actual paper-output settings
inputs: checked pattern requirements and chosen dimensions
outputs: checked exact final pattern and actual-size paper-output settings

steps.what: Render the checked final pattern at actual size onto the paper cutting sheet
inputs: checked exact final pattern and actual-size paper-output settings
outputs: actual paper pattern at checked scale

steps.what: Cut actual paper patterns and physically verify dimensions and cut edges
inputs: actual paper pattern at checked scale
checked pattern requirements and chosen dimensions

tasks.design: Configure selected geometry reuse and actual-size paper output in the actual pattern-drawing application, OTHER, replacing a real manual transfer of checked geometry onto paper where that work exists. Retain specification interpretation, substantive drawing adaptation, full pattern/output checks and all physical cutting; paper output has its own final-version gate.
tasks.previous_blocker: Selected geometry can be redrawn and checked geometry manually transferred onto paper.
tasks.enabler_now: Native pattern sections and actual-size output can remove those defined drawing operations.
tasks.still_hard: Pattern suitability, scale verification and accurate physical cutting require the sewer.
tasks.human_edge: The sewer notices a seam or scale mismatch that would spoil the actual item.
tasks.altitude: Reduce selected drawing reuse and actual paper-transfer work.

evidence.claim: Model knowledge: native pattern geometry reuse and actual-size printing can replace manual redraw/transfer for compatible patterns.

assumptions: Provisional drawing25 removes five repeated geometry points; paper-transfer10 is actual manual redraw of already checked geometry, replaced by actual-size printer/plotter output. This is conditional on that actual route and available suitable output hardware; do not invent the transfer or claim benefit where patterns are already printed. Specification owner supplies actual revision/dimensions/seams; sewer verifies30, adapts retained drawing20 and checks final geometry/scale10.

Missing compatible geometry requires manual drawing. Gate binds exact generated pattern and paper-output settings after full check, not ordinary author saving. Actual paper/cut scale verification stays within25. No autonomous fabric cutting or nesting improvement is claimed; existing reuse/output gets zero credit. No extra report or send is invented.
unknowns: Is actual checked geometry manually transferred to paper, and is suitable actual-size output available?
research_questions: Can output preserve actual scale and seam allowances without hidden print scaling?

incremental.description: Maintain selected pattern sections and verify actual-size output compatibility.

approvals.approved_version: s3 exact final pattern geometry, scale and paper-output settings; edits void output authorization

time_saved_range_pct.basis: High removes5 selected drawing points plus10 actual manual paper-transfer points minus0.8 upkeep=14.2. Low: an irregular pattern needs bespoke drawing and manual paper treatment, leaving only1 reusable geometry point and2 compatible paper-transfer points removable, minus0.8=2.2. Specification, adaptation, whole checks and all physical cutting remain; absent manual transfer or available output, remove that branch and its benefit.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

role.altitude: Retain physical hand sewing while reducing actual compatible pattern drawing operations.
skills_to_grow: Check pattern geometry, seams and output scale
